title: Leek and new potato tray hash with eggs

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Potatoes, leeks, broccoli, eggs, Cheddar, oil and herbs are all plain kitchen and garden foods.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient, including purple sprouting broccoli in April, is an everyday Tesco item.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a roasting tray, knife and grater, and the technique is simple roasting and baking eggs.

works.reason: 600g potatoes, three leeks, 200g broccoli and an egg each make a sensible breakfast for four, and the 220°C timings cook the potatoes through and set the eggs.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes is enough to halve the potatoes, wash and slice the leeks, trim the broccoli and grate the cheese, and 20+12+8 minutes matches the 40 cook minutes.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, nothing unlisted appears, and the names match their ids.

seasonal_feel.reason: Three leeks with late-April sprouting broccoli make a warm tray breakfast that suits a cool spring morning, and the leeks are central rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English.

hearty_healthy.reason: Potatoes, two green vegetables, eggs and cheese make a filling, balanced cooked breakfast a family would want again.
